findings.defect: Unescaped vertical bars in |v|, g_h/|g_h| and 1/|g_h| split the Markdown table into extra cells.
findings.correction: Escape all magnitude delimiter pipes inside table cells, or use magnitude(v) notation.
findings.verification_method: Inspect table row delimiter counts after correction.
findings.verification_result: Magnitude delimiters are escaped or replaced by magnitude(...) notation; all table rows now have four cells by unescaped-delimiter check.

findings.defect: CAP-05 requires a computed physical cosine, but the only prior answered practice C04.05-P1 computes zero dot products and a squared length. The cosine formula is explained and worked in W1, yet no learner practice item asks for a cosine calculation. E05 requires prior independently answered practice for each concrete operation.
findings.correction: Add a short answered practice asking learners to compute a nonzero physical cosine from two address displacements using their physical images; map that practice explicitly in CAP-05. For example e1 and (1,1,0) map to (1,0,0) and (2,2,0), giving cosine 1/sqrt(2).
findings.verification_method: Inspect new practice prompt and worked answer; independently recompute dot 2 and magnitudes 1,sqrt(8), then confirm capstone backward map cites it.
findings.verification_result: Re-read updated C04.05-P1, new C04.05-P2 and CAP-05 E05 row. P1 now practices zero cosines; P2 explicitly prompts physical images, dot product, magnitudes and nonzero cosine, with correct worked answer. Independently recomputed dot=2, squared magnitudes=1,8, hence cosine=1/sqrt(2). CAP-05 explicitly links P2. Finding closed.
